C3: six fresh headless Oh My Pi sessions (three roles x two checkouts), composed through workerPane() with a composer of my own ($TMPDIR/infra336t/compose2.ts, which splits the daemon's --append-system-prompt shell text with the shell rather than a regular expression) and given tasks of my own, one of them the planner role the implementer never ran. failures.criterion: C2 (A2, R2): the skill-scenario harness scores a tester handoff written to the new shape — but it now refuses the shape every other checkout's prompt spells, so the harness's documented two-label comparison measures the prompt change and not the rule
failures.evidence: `previousHandoff: z.string()` in packages/pi-legion/scripts/skill-scenarios/score.ts:107 is required. Each label's agent gets the role prompt of its own checkout (packages/pi-legion/scripts/skill-scenarios/worker-pane.ts:54 passes `path.join(checkout, "packages", "daemon")` as the pane's daemon module), while one scorer reads every label's runs (rig.sh:1560, `bun "$here/score.ts" runs "$work/runs"`). The documented comparison is `./rig.sh batch tester-proof 5 head base` (packages/pi-envoy/scripts/README.md:269), base being a checkout of main. Measured: main's tester prompt, composed at 92619d8df, carries `completed: "<RFC 3339 UTC time of writing>"` twice and the string `previousHandoff` zero times, so a base-label tester writes `completed` and no `previousHandoff`; `TestHandoff.safeParse` of that body prints `base-arm parses: false` and `✖ Invalid input: expected string, received undefined → at previousHandoff`, which testerProof (score.ts:714) records as `proofProblems=["not a test handoff: …"]` and scores `pass=false`. Before this change the bias ran the other way and no checkout met it: both prompts asked for `completed`. Red test: `test("a tester handoff of a checkout whose prompt predates previousHandoff is read too")` in packages/pi-legion/scripts/skill-scenarios/score.test.ts, commit df06144227c0. `cd packages/pi-legion && bun test scripts/skill-scenarios/score.test.ts` prints `67 pass, 1 fail` with `expect(received).toBe(expected) Expected: true Received: false` at that test. Measured fix: `previousHandoff: z.string().optional()` makes it `68 pass, 0 fail` and leaves the implementer's own new case passing; the schema was then restored with `jj restore`, so the branch carries the red test and not the fix.

failures.criterion: R3 and D4: `previousHandoff` closes the identical-body round — but the revset the prompt tells a worker to read it with answers nothing, silently, whenever the shell's directory is not the workspace root, which writes the empty string and reproduces the HANDOFF_NOT_NEW the field exists to close
failures.evidence: packages/daemon/internal/prompts/go/worker-common.md:21 gives `jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" log --no-graph -r 'latest((::@- ~ ::trunk()) & files(".legion/<issue>/<phase>.json"))' -T commit_id`, whose fileset has no `root:` prefix, so jj resolves it against the shell's working directory while `-R` fixes only the repository. The function this mirrors, findHandoffCommit (packages/pi-shared/src/handoff-commit.ts:114-124), uses `files(root:".legion/<KEY>/<phase>.json")`. Measured in this workspace at ffc0ee86: from the workspace root the prompt's command prints `ffc0ee86308052942b660d85cbe686a51eec1e1b`; run unchanged from `packages/pi-legion` it prints nothing and exits 0; the same command with `root:` added prints `ffc0ee86308052942b660d85cbe686a51eec1e1b` from `packages/pi-legion` too. The prompt then tells the worker to write `""` (`an empty string when that command prints nothing`), which is what a first round writes, so a second round at an unmoved head writes its predecessor's bytes again. Measured consequence in a scratch jj repository ($TMPDIR/infra336t/c6.sh): round 2 with `previousHandoff` at round 1's commit makes a non-empty commit (826b49a5adfff252159c1d968e8daf661b9ed091, `jj log -r @- -T empty` prints false), while the byte-identical round 3 makes an empty commit (`empty` prints true) and findHandoffCommit's own revset answers round 2's commit again — the HANDOFF_NOT_NEW refusal (packages/daemon/internal/workflow/engine.go). The failure is silent: no error, exit 0, an empty answer that reads like `there is no previous handoff`. Fix: add `root:` to the fileset in that one sentence, so the prompt's command and findHandoffCommit agree. No red test: the repository pins no prompt wording (the plan's D6), and a test of this text would be a source-text pin.
